steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Review PMI's official eligibility criteria to confirm you meet the education and experience threshold before enrolling in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend all sessions synchronously from Amarillo or anywhere with internet access. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world examples and exam-focused content across the full 35-hour requirement.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, complete your formal PMP application through PMI's online portal and remit the examination fee. Your Granite PM Academy completion certificate satisfies the required training credential. Allow time for PMI to review and approve your application before scheduling your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor review sessions—to strengthen your readiness. Schedule your computer-based exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. The PMP is a rigorous, comprehensive assessment; our support helps you approach it with confidence.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification renews every three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through PMI-approved activities, training, or volunteer work. Staying current keeps your credential active and demonstrates ongoing commitment to project-management excellence in Amarillo's energy, manufacturing, and healthcare sectors.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
